title: ChatGPT jawab kaise banata hai?
hooks: ChatGPT insaan ki tarah dimaag laga kar jawab nahi deta.
Aapka ChatGPT asal mein sirf ek super-smart guesser hai.
ChatGPT kabhi poora sentence ek saath nahi sochta.
hook_why: Busts the illusion of AI consciousness in frame 0 and creates immediate curiosity about how it actually writes.
metaphor: A super-fast smartphone auto-complete looping through next-token probabilities.

scenes.prompt: Cinematic macro shot of a sleek smartphone screen glowing softly in a dark studio, a single minimalist glowing green cursor blinking steadily, dark glass reflection, pure black background, no text, no icons.
scenes.label: THE ILLUSION
scenes.vo: ChatGPT insaan ki tarah dimaag laga kar jawab nahi deta.
Toh phir itne smart aur lambe answers bante kaise hain?

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic studio product shot of a floating minimalist dark mechanical keyboard key with subtle turquoise neon edge glow, isolated on pure black background, cinematic lighting, no text.
scenes.label: AUTO-COMPLETE
scenes.vo: Asal mein ChatGPT phone ke auto-complete ka ek super-sized roop hai.

scenes.label: STEP 1: TOKENS
scenes.vo: Aapka sawaal aate hi yeh use chhote tukdon yani tokens mein todta hai.

scenes.title: AGLE SHABD KA CHANCE
scenes.label: STEP 2: MATH
scenes.vo: Fir agla sabse sahi shabd aane ka chance calculate hota hai.

scenes.label: ONE BY ONE
scenes.vo: Ek baar mein poora jawab nahi, bas agla ek tukda banta hai.

scenes.label: FEEDBACK LOOP
scenes.vo: Naya shabd chunte hi, yeh use pichle sentence ke aage jod deta hai.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic glowing circular data stream ring looping smoothly into itself, neon cyan and deep amber particles on a pure black background, 3D render, no text.
scenes.label: CONTINUOUS LOOP
scenes.vo: Ab naye sentence ko dobara padh kar, agla shabd predict hota hai.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic studio render of a high-tech matte dark processor chip with sharp golden rim light, glowing circuitry lines pulsing on black background, macro detail, zero text.
scenes.label: MICROSECOND SPEED
scenes.vo: Yeh cycle microsecond mein ghoomti hai, isliye lagta hai live typing chal rahi hai.

scenes.prompt: Photorealistic minimalist translucent glass dice with tiny glowing amber nodes suspended inside, resting on dark reflective studio surface with subtle blue rim light, no text.
scenes.label: MATH NOT MIND
scenes.vo: Matlab ChatGPT kuch samajhta nahi, bas mathematics ka sabse tagda guesser hai.
Kabhi ChatGPT ne aapke sawaal ka ajeeb ya galat jawab diya hai?

caption: ChatGPT sochta nahi, bas predict karta hai! Agla shabd chunne ka ye math jaankar dimaag hil jaayega. Kya aapke saath kabhi ChatGPT ne galat jawab diya hai?

claims.claim: ChatGPT generates text sequentially one token at a time (autoregressive generation)
claims.basis: Standard Transformer autoregressive decoder architecture (Vaswani et al. 2017, OpenAI GPT papers).

claims.claim: Input text is broken into sub-word tokens before processing
claims.basis: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization documented in OpenAI GPT tokenizer specifications.

claims.claim: The next token is chosen using calculated probability distributions over vocabulary
claims.basis: Softmax distribution over token logits used in standard LLM inference.
